valid_fixes: Change IngestFunction Environment.Variables.STREAM_NAME from the hardcoded wrong name back to !Ref IngestStream so the ingest function addresses the existing stream
invalid_patches: Create a second Kinesis stream named '<stack>-ingest-data' to match the env var (creates a new resource rather than fixing the misconfiguration)
Rename IngestStream.Name to end in '-ingest-data' (changes the actual resource name, breaking all existing references)
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_invoke_lambda(IngestFunction, payload) → runtime error response; ace_get_log_tail(IngestFunction) → ResourceNotFoundException: Stream <stack>-ingest-data not found
ace_get_environment_variables(IngestFunction) → STREAM_NAME: <stack>-ingest-data; name does not match actual stream
ace_list_resources(AWS::Kinesis::Stream) → actual stream physical ID is <stack>-ingest-stream; mismatch confirmed
observable_symptom: The ingest endpoint returns HTTP 500 immediately for every request. Logs show a resource-not-found error naming a stream that does not exist. The actual streaming infrastructure is deployed and healthy.
root_cause: The ingest function's environment variable STREAM_NAME resolves to '<stack>-ingest-data', but the actual stream is named '<stack>-ingest-stream'. Every put_record call raises ResourceNotFoundException, causing the function to return a 500 runtime error.
